content: We assume that an individual stock news as the one that explicitly mention the stock name or any of its surface forms in the headline. As an illustration, in order to collect all news for the stock code PG, Procter & Gamble company name, we search all the headlines with any of these words: Procter&Gamble OR Procter and Gamble OR P&G. In this example, the first word is just the company name and the remaining words are the company surface forms.
